_description: 問診題庫。axis_positioning 是六軸定位 12 題(A/B1/B2/C1/C2/D 各 2 題,2026-10 從四軸 16 題改版——B 拆成 B1 外線投射/B2 禁區低位得分,C 拆成 C1 外圍防守/C2 禁區護框防守,理由跟校準依據見下方 _editable_fields 與 docs/superpowers/plans),skill_behavior 是完整 15 項技能(SPEC.md §3.3)的行為錨定題(目前每項技能 1 題,共 15 題),body_measurements 是 SPEC.md §5.2 身材類的 6 題數值題(給「3 位深度模板」的身體最貼合用)。目前合計 33 題。axis_positioning/skill_behavior 都是 BARS(行為錨定評分量表,見 SPEC.md §5.1)——問的是具體行為/頻率,不是自評能力高低;body_measurements 例外,是直接填數值,不是 BARS。
_editable_fields: axis_positioning/skill_behavior 每題的 prompt(題目文字)跟 anchors(1-5 每個分數對應的行為描述)可以照 BARS 精神修改用詞,body_measurements 每題的 prompt/unit/min/max 可以依實際需求調整,但改的時候要小心三件事:(1) id 一旦被其他地方引用(例如 skill_behavior 的 skill_id 對應 skills.json 的技能 id;body_measurements 的 field 對應 players.json 的 body 欄位名)就不要改,否則資料兜不起來;(2) 每題的 anchors 必須維持 1-5 五個完整的行為描述,不能只改數字不改文字,否則就違背了 BARS 的設計目的;(3) body_measurements 的 field 全部六項(height_cm/wingspan_cm/weight_kg/standing_reach_cm/running_vertical_reach_cm/sprint_100m_seconds)都已經對應到 players.json 每個球員的 body 欄位,新增題目要小心維持這個對應關係。要新增題目就照現有的物件格式加進對應的陣列。body_measurements 的 body_height/body_weight 標了 required:true——身高、體重是原型分類(engine/archetype.py 的體型分數)的必要輸入,沒填無法算,所以改成必填,其餘四題(臂展/摸高/衝刺)維持選填,省略 required 等同 false(2026-10 討論,見 engine/body_fit.py 的 missing_required_body_fields)。axis_positioning 支援 "reverse_scored": true(見 engine/axis_position.py 的 score_axis_coordinates,分數會自動 6-score 反轉再平均),但目前這 12 題沒有一題用到——六軸改版時發現舊版 B 軸(axis_b1-b4)問的其實是「站位偏好」而非「投籃實力」、舊版 axis_c1 問的是「教練角色分配」而非「禁區防守能力」,這正是 2K 數值比對發現 B、C 兩軸系統性低估中鋒的根本原因之一(見 2026-10 討論);改版後每題都直接問「成功率/把握度」這種表現型描述,不再需要用 reverse_scored 去扭轉站位類問題的方向。新增題目如果又要用「字面頻率跟軸方向相反」的寫法,一樣可以加這個欄位,但建議優先改寫成直接的表現型問法。

axis_positioning.prompt: When the defense traps you, what's your first reaction?

anchors.1: I freeze up completely and get stripped or turn it over
anchors.2: I barely squeeze the ball out, but usually lose my rhythm
anchors.3: I can get the pass out, but a bit slowly
anchors.4: I consistently find the open teammate
anchors.5: I read the trap coming and find the next open man ahead of time

axis_positioning.prompt: In a single game, about how many times do you drive off the dribble to score or set up a teammate?

anchors.1: 0 times -- I almost never dribble more than two steps
anchors.2: 1-2 times, only occasionally
anchors.3: 3-5 times, a moderate amount
anchors.4: 6-9 times -- I'm one of the main initiators
anchors.5: 10+ times -- the team runs its offense through me

axis_positioning.prompt: When you get an open look from the perimeter, about how often do you knock it down?

anchors.1: Rarely goes in -- I usually look to pass instead
anchors.2: Goes in occasionally, but I'd often rather pass
anchors.3: About half the time, depends on my feel that day
anchors.4: Goes in most of the time -- it's a reliable weapon for me
anchors.5: Nearly automatic -- defenses specifically scramble to chase me off it

axis_positioning.prompt: How would you describe your confidence in the pull-up jumper off the dribble (mid-range or three)?

anchors.1: I almost never pull up for this shot
anchors.2: I attempt it occasionally, with a low success rate
anchors.3: Moderate -- I take it depending on the situation
anchors.4: It's a shot I trust -- I take it with confidence most of the time
anchors.5: It's my signature move -- teammates trust me to take it

axis_positioning.prompt: Backing a defender down with the ball, with them wedged between you and the rim, what portion of the time can you score directly off footwork or a post move?

anchors.1: I almost never post up
anchors.2: I attempt it occasionally, with a low success rate
anchors.3: About half the time
anchors.4: I can usually create a good look with footwork or a pivot
anchors.5: I create a high-percentage shot almost every time

axis_positioning.prompt: How confident are you finishing at short range (from the rim out to the free-throw line)?

anchors.1: I rarely get the chance, or can't convert when I do
anchors.2: I occasionally finish, but often get blocked or miss
anchors.3: About half the time, depending on the matchup
anchors.4: I finish most of the time -- my touch is reliable there
anchors.5: It's an automatic scoring zone for me -- defenses specifically worry about it

axis_positioning.prompt: When guarding a perimeter ball-handler, what portion of the time can you stay glued to them for the full possession without losing contact?

anchors.1: I can barely hold on -- they create separation immediately
anchors.2: I can rarely keep up
anchors.3: I can keep up about half the time
anchors.4: I can keep up most of the time
anchors.5: I can stay locked on for almost the whole possession

axis_positioning.prompt: After switching onto a perimeter shooter, what portion of the time can you prevent them from getting an easy open look?

anchors.1: They almost always get separation easily
anchors.2: I can rarely contain them
anchors.3: About half the time
anchors.4: I can contain them most of the time
anchors.5: I can contain them almost every time -- they struggle to get a shot off

axis_positioning.prompt: On defense, how often does the coach assign you to help-defend, box out, or protect the paint?

anchors.1: Almost never me
anchors.2: Rarely me
anchors.3: About half the time
anchors.4: Often me
anchors.5: Almost always me

axis_positioning.prompt: When you step in to help or contest a direct rim attack, what portion of the time do you actually disrupt or alter the shot?

anchors.1: I rarely help -- I'm usually a step late or pick up a foul
anchors.2: I disrupt it occasionally, but inconsistently
anchors.3: About half the time
anchors.4: I create an effective contest or block most of the time
anchors.5: I'm a wall at the rim -- opponents actively avoid that side

axis_positioning.prompt: On fast breaks, how often are you the first one down the floor to finish (layup / dunk)?

anchors.1: Almost never me
anchors.2: Rarely me
anchors.3: About half the time
anchors.4: Often me
anchors.5: Almost always the first one down the floor

axis_positioning.prompt: In a single game, about how many times can you elevate high enough to finish a put-back dunk or a block?

anchors.1: 0 times -- I can barely get above my opponent
anchors.2: 1 time, only occasionally
anchors.3: 2-3 times
anchors.4: 4-5 times
anchors.5: 6+ times -- it's one of my regular weapons

skill_behavior.prompt: When the defender sags off and leaves you open beyond the three-point line, do you take the shot?

anchors.1: Never -- I'll take one more dribble or pass instead
anchors.2: Rarely take the shot
anchors.3: Take the shot about half the time
anchors.4: Often take the shot, and with real confidence
anchors.5: Always take the shot -- if I see the rim, I feel it's going in

skill_behavior.prompt: Facing up with the ball against a defender in a set stance, do you actively try to beat them off the first step?

anchors.1: Never -- I'll pass or pull up for a mid-range shot instead
anchors.2: Rarely try, and mostly fail when I do
anchors.3: Occasionally try, with roughly a fifty-fifty success rate
anchors.4: Often try, and usually get by or draw a foul
anchors.5: Always try, and defenders struggle to stay in front of me with positioning alone

skill_behavior.prompt: When you catch the ball at the high post and get trapped, what's your first reaction?

anchors.1: I always turn it over
anchors.2: I usually barely squeeze out a dribble
anchors.3: I can get a pass out, but slowly
anchors.4: I can find the open man
anchors.5: I can find the next open man down the line

skill_behavior.prompt: When you're the primary defender and the ball-handler attacks the paint head-on, what portion of the time do you stop them (steal / block / force a miss)?

anchors.1: Never -- they almost always score or draw a foul
anchors.2: Rarely stop them
anchors.3: Stop them about half the time
anchors.4: Often stop them
anchors.5: Almost always stop them -- they rarely score easily

skill_behavior.prompt: After switching onto a perimeter ball-handler, what portion of the time can you stay glued to them the whole way without giving up separation?

anchors.1: Never -- they get separation immediately after the switch
anchors.2: I can rarely keep up
anchors.3: I can keep up about half the time
anchors.4: I can often keep up
anchors.5: I can almost always keep up -- opponents struggle to hunt me on switches

skill_behavior.prompt: Catching the ball with your back to the basket and the defender sealed between you and the rim, what do you do?

anchors.1: I pass right back out or give up the post-up -- I won't try to force it
anchors.2: I rarely force it, and it mostly ends in failure
anchors.3: I occasionally force it, with about a fifty-fifty success rate
anchors.4: I often force it, and usually finish or draw a foul
anchors.5: I always force it -- opponents struggle to guard me one-on-one

skill_behavior.prompt: The moment a ball-screen opens up and the defense switches or hedges, what do you usually do?

anchors.1: I can't react in time -- I often dribble into a body or get stripped
anchors.2: I only have one go-to option (always drive, or always shoot), regardless of the coverage
anchors.3: I can pick between two options depending on the situation, but I'm often a beat slow
anchors.4: I can make the right choice among pass / shoot / drive based on the coverage
anchors.5: I can read the defensive gap and make the best choice almost instantly, nearly every time

skill_behavior.prompt: When a teammate sets a screen to try to spring you open, what do you do?

anchors.1: I often stand still or cut the wrong way, wasting the screen
anchors.2: I rarely come out of it truly open
anchors.3: I use the screen to get open about half the time
anchors.4: I often use the screen well and get open for the catch
anchors.5: I almost always read the defense and get to the best possible spot

skill_behavior.prompt: When you're the first one to the rim on a fast break, what portion of the time do you finish cleanly?

anchors.1: I almost always turn it over or get blocked
anchors.2: I can rarely finish cleanly
anchors.3: I finish about half the time
anchors.4: I often finish
anchors.5: I almost always finish, and often draw an extra foul doing it

skill_behavior.prompt: Standing at the free-throw line, how confident are you that it's going in?

anchors.1: Not confident at all -- I miss often
anchors.2: Not very confident -- my percentage is on the low side
anchors.3: Roughly fifty-fifty
anchors.4: Confident -- I usually make it
anchors.5: Practically automatic, even in high-pressure clutch situations

skill_behavior.prompt: The instant a teammate's shot misses, what do you do?

anchors.1: I rarely crash the paint for the offensive board
anchors.2: I occasionally crash, but mostly come up empty
anchors.3: I crash in about half the time, and often come away with it
anchors.4: I often crash the offensive glass on purpose, with a decent success rate
anchors.5: I almost always box out and crash on purpose, and consistently come away with the ball

skill_behavior.prompt: Guarding the ball-handler one-on-one as they try to drive past you, what portion of the time do you keep them in front of you without getting beaten easily?

anchors.1: I can barely hold my ground -- beaten on the first step almost every time
anchors.2: I can rarely hold my ground
anchors.3: I can hold my ground about half the time
anchors.4: I can often hold my ground
anchors.5: I can almost always hold my ground -- opponents struggle to beat me one-on-one

skill_behavior.prompt: When a teammate gets beaten and needs your help defense, what portion of the time do you rotate to the right spot in time?

anchors.1: I'm almost always late or rotate to the wrong spot
anchors.2: I can rarely rotate to the right spot in time
anchors.3: I rotate correctly about half the time
anchors.4: I often rotate to the right spot in time
anchors.5: I almost always rotate correctly in time, and can still recover to my own man

skill_behavior.prompt: The instant the opponent takes a shot, what do you do?

anchors.1: I rarely box out first -- opponents often slip behind me for the rebound
anchors.2: I occasionally box out, but often lose the position battle
anchors.3: I box out about half the time, and often win the position battle
anchors.4: I often box out on purpose, and usually win the position battle
anchors.5: I almost always seal good position -- opponents struggle to get around me for the board

skill_behavior.prompt: When you're trapped with the ball or facing high-pressure defense, how often do you turn it over on the spot?

anchors.1: I always turn it over
anchors.2: I often barely squeeze out a dribble or force a bad pass
anchors.3: I can hold onto the ball, but it often takes a long time to find a way out
anchors.4: I can settle the ball quickly and usually handle it safely
anchors.5: I almost never turn it over, and can even keep the offense efficient under pressure

body_measurements.prompt: Wingspan (fingertip-to-fingertip with both arms fully extended)
Standing reach (feet flat on the ground, highest point one hand can reach)
Running vertical reach (highest point one hand can touch off a running jump)
